# AON-1 design basis (generated by design/design.py)

3U CubeSat, 100.0 x 100.0 x 340.5 mm [3.937 x 3.937 x 13.406 in] on four 8.5 mm hard-anodised 6061-T6 rails. Launched from Ambient's own AODV-1 dispenser (built to CubeSat Design Specification rev 14.1 3U numbers so a commercial rideshare dispenser also fits).

## Orbit [asm/calc]
- 500 km circular, sun-synchronous ~97.4° if the AODV-1 trajectory allows, else the launch-site latitude; 500 km circular [asm]
- Period 94.6 min, worst eclipse 35.8 min, sunlit fraction ≥ 62 %
- Natural decay to re-entry ≈ 1.9 years at 1.93 kg (simple exponential atmosphere, moderate solar activity [est]); FCC 5-year rule: met

## Power [calc]
- 7 cells per long face in series: string Vmp 16.9 V, Voc at -40 °C ≈ 20.4 V; one face in full sun ≈ 6.3 W after losses
- Orbit-average generation: tumbling 3.08 W, spinning about Z with the sun broadside 5.00 W
- Orbit-average load 1.81 W  ->  margin 70 % tumbling, 176 % spinning
- Battery 2S2P 18650: 50.9 Wh; worst eclipse uses 1.08 Wh = 2.1 % depth of discharge

| Load | W on | Duty | Avg W |
|---|---|---|---|
| OBC STM32H743 + FRAM + NOR + sensors | 0.45 | 1.000 | 0.450 |
| EPS quiescent (MPPT, regulators, monitors) | 0.20 | 1.000 | 0.200 |
| COM receiver (always listening) | 0.24 | 1.000 | 0.240 |
| COM transmit beacon 2 W RF (1 s every 30 s) | 6.50 | 0.033 | 0.217 |
| COM transmit pass downlink (3 passes x 6 min/day) | 6.50 | 0.013 | 0.081 |
| ADCS magnetorquers (B-dot / pointing, average) | 0.35 | 0.500 | 0.175 |
| Battery heater (cold case, thermostat duty) | 2.00 | 0.100 | 0.200 |
| Payload bay reserve | 0.50 | 0.500 | 0.250 |

## UHF link [calc]
- 401.5 MHz placeholder, 9600 bit/s GMSK BT 0.5 (G3RUH-compatible framing replaced by CCSDS TM/TC, see firmware)
- Worst case at 10° elevation: slant range 1695 km, path loss 149.1 dB
- Downlink (2 W, dipole, 15.5 dBi crossed Yagi): Eb/N0 23.3 dB, margin 10.7 dB over 10.6 dB for 1e-5 BER
- Uplink (50 W): Eb/N0 35.1 dB, margin 22.5 dB
- Throughput about 0.9 MB/day over 3 passes (70 % framing efficiency)
- Frequency is a placeholder in the 400.15-403 MHz space operation band: final frequency comes from the FCC/ITU filing (50-certification-path.md). Amateur 435-438 MHz is not usable for a commercial messaging mission.

## Deployment and inhibits [req]
- Antenna release no earlier than 30 min after separation; first RF no earlier than 45 min.
- Burn wire: 4.7 Ω resistor, 1.0 A for 6.0 s, up to 4 retries, release confirmed by element switches.
- Battery/deploy inhibits: deployment switch SW1 (-Z rail end, battery minus); deployment switch SW2 (-Z rail end, battery plus); remove-before-flight pin RBF1 (solar + battery path)
- RF inhibits: SW1/SW2 (no battery to COM until deployed); EPS COM load switch, enabled by OBC only after t_rf; COM PA enable line, separate GPIO with its own 45 min hardware timer (TPL5111 on E04)
